description: Schematic of DDR2 (Q16832, 855 aa) domain architecture with SMED-SL/AC loss-of-function variants vs Warburg-Cinotti gain-of-function variants mapped to residues
code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches

# DDR2 (UniProt Q16832), 855 aa. Approx domain boundaries (UniProt/InterPro)
L = 855
domains = [
    ("Signal", 1, 21, "#cccccc"),
    ("Discoidin (DS)\ncollagen-binding", 30, 185, "#4C72B0"),
    ("DS-like", 190, 371, "#8FB0DD"),
    ("Extracellular\nlinker", 372, 398, "#e8e8e8"),
    ("TM", 399, 421, "#555555"),
    ("Juxtamembrane", 422, 562, "#DDCC77"),
    ("Tyrosine kinase", 563, 849, "#C44E52"),
]

# Disease variants
smed = [  # SMED-SL/AC, biallelic loss-of-function (recessive)
    (124, "R124W"),
    (713, "T713I"),
    (726, "I726R"),
    (752, "R752C"),
    (770, "IVS17+1\n(splice)"),  # approx position near exon17/kinase
]
wc = [  # Warburg-Cinotti, activating gain-of-function (dominant)
    (610, "L610P"),
    (740, "Y740C"),
]

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(13, 4.2))

# Protein backbone
ax.add_patch(mpatches.Rectangle((1, 0.45), L, 0.10, color="#f0f0f0", ec="k", lw=0.5))
for name, s, e, c in domains:
    ax.add_patch(mpatches.Rectangle((s, 0.40), e-s, 0.20, color=c, ec="k", lw=0.6))
    if e-s > 25:
        ax.text((s+e)/2, 0.50, name, ha="center", va="center", fontsize=7.5,
                color="white" if c in ("#4C72B0","#C44E52","#555555") else "black")

# LoF variants (above)
for pos, lab in smed:
    ax.plot([pos, pos], [0.60, 0.78], color="#2b2b2b", lw=1)
    ax.plot(pos, 0.80, "o", color="#C44E52", ms=9, mec="k")
    ax.text(pos, 0.86, lab, ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=7.5, rotation=0)

# GoF variants (below)
for pos, lab in wc:
    ax.plot([pos, pos], [0.22, 0.40], color="#2b2b2b", lw=1)
    ax.plot(pos, 0.20, "s", color="#55A868", ms=9, mec="k")
    ax.text(pos, 0.14, lab, ha="center", va="top", fontsize=7.5)

ax.text(430, 0.955, "SMED-SL/AC — biallelic LOSS-of-function (recessive)",
        ha="center", fontsize=10, color="#C44E52", weight="bold")
ax.text(675, 0.045, "Warburg-Cinotti — activating GAIN-of-function (dominant)",
        ha="center", fontsize=10, color="#55A868", weight="bold")

ax.set_xlim(-30, L+70); ax.set_ylim(0, 1.0)
ax.set_xlabel("DDR2 residue (aa)  |  UniProt Q16832, 855 aa", fontsize=9)
ax.set_yticks([]); 
for sp in ["left","right","top"]:
    ax.spines[sp].set_visible(False)
ax.set_title("DDR2 variant landscape: opposite-direction alleles cause two distinct diseases", fontsize=11)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig("ddr2_variant_landscape.png", dpi=150, bbox_inches="tight")
print("saved figure")

# Quick sanity check of interpretation
print("\nLoF variants: 1 in discoidin (collagen-binding), 3 in kinase domain, 1 splice near kinase")
print("GoF variants: both within kinase domain (L610 N-lobe region, Y740 activation loop)")
print("Interpretation consistent: LoF spread across binding+catalysis; GoF specifically in kinase catalytic core.")
